name: x86-64 AVX-512BW (512-bit byte/word operations)
description: 512-bit vectors with byte and word granularity. 64 input bytes per iteration but still limited to in-lane shuffles without VBMI.

key_instructions.purpose: In-lane byte shuffle on 64 bytes. Same 16-byte lane limitation as AVX2 vpshufb.
key_instructions.note: Skylake-SP/X: only port 5 for ZMM shuffles (1 CPI). Zen4 cracks 512b ops into 2x256b.
Skylake-SP: p0/p5 both handle 512b multiply (0.5 CPI). Ice Lake: only p0 (1.0 CPI).

key_instructions.purpose: Cross-lane dword permutation for output compaction.

base64_applicability: Fallback for AVX-512 hardware without VBMI (Skylake-SP/X, Knights Mill). Uses same algorithm as AVX2 but with wider vectors. Benefits from doubled iteration size but shuffle port pressure is the bottleneck. Key limitation: no cross-lane byte permute (vpermb) so output compaction requires multi-step shuffle. On Skylake-SP, the multiply throughput advantage (0.5 CPI) partially compensates.
